goal: Apply the representative-property-transport-total-coverage mechanism to the complete preregistered R43 83-case universe and determine whether a truth-blind structural quotient preserves the property Q(x)=the frozen R42 controller reaches a verified semantic decision. Extract a class-level stall mechanism without patching R42.

formal_mechanism.allowed_inference: Q(rep_i) AND FOR_ALL x IN C_i:Transport_Q(rep_i,x) AND U=UNION_i C_i IMPLIES FOR_ALL x IN U:Q(x)

candidate_truth_blind_quotient.note: The candidate quotient may merge decided and stalled cases. Such a merge is not repaired post hoc: it must appear as F>0.

transport_certificate.additional_decided_consistency: If both are semantically decided, their individual frozen-controller verification/replay must pass; SAT/UNSAT values need not match because Q is decision-completeness, not truth value.

metrics.R: states not assigned exactly once to a quotient class
metrics.Q_false: raw cases where frozen R42 fails to reach a semantic decision
metrics.K_stall: quotient classes whose representative has Q=false
metrics.seed_43004_class_size: size of the candidate quotient class containing the sealed first counterexample

PASS_iff: every semantically decided case passes its own frozen-controller verification/replay
universal_decision_gate.expected_from_sealed_R43: MUST_NOT_PASS because seed 43004 is already a sealed Q=false witness
universal_decision_gate.important: R44 success means the audit behaves soundly and extracts the failure class; it does not mean R42 regains L2.

pyramid_adversarial_control.broken_branch_expected: unsafe level-only quotient must produce F>0
pyramid_adversarial_control.boundary_dependency_expected: K=N and compression must be refused

status_separation.FINITE_TRANSPORT_AUDIT_CERTIFIED: R=0 and all reported F are exact rechecks over every member
status_separation.POLYNOMIALITY_PROVEN: requires symbolic all-n quotient-growth and certificate-cost proof; finite runs cannot set this true

captain_command.if_mixed_class: Treat F>0 as a counterexample to the candidate quotient signature. Refine only with predecision structural invariants; never add Q itself to the signature to erase the failure.
captain_command.if_pure_stall_class: Use the certified stall class as the target for a genuinely new R45 successor operator or representation.
